lens: Geometry and proportion first, re-baselined on the re-aimed q15 (row 34 D-G head-on like y_47300; scale check: back width 140 px render vs 125 px photo, back top-to-crease / width 1.95 vs 2.06, so the views match within ~12 %), then materials, colour, lighting and artefacts. Econ code is identical to w23, so the close-ups e1-e9 were only re-checked by eye and against y_47302 / 47306; the score moves because the matched camera exposes proportions the old q15 hid. Measured (raterB24/m.py, prof.py): per-seat patches in q15 vs y_47300 (mean RGB, L, B/R, p10/50/90, p90/50, bright = fraction of pixels above 1.4x the patch median), cover extents from dark-flat row / column runs, row profiles under the covers, arm colour against the ceiling white balance, diamond patches in e1 vs y_47302 / 47306. In-flight check: b_ss_12-18 re-downloaded to ref/web/econ (gitignored). Scratch crops: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/9bd9f3c4-d0cf-5926-80e2-5fc8be0f1dcf/scratchpad/raterB24/ (z_q15pair.png, z_head.png, z_pans.png, z_arm.png, z_q16.png, z_q18.png, z_ss13.png).
